generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The `// TODO: Choose a good default.` indicates the 4096 capacity is a placeholder. Before this ships, it would be good to either validate the value under realistic load (e.g. measure the peak number of in-flight buffers per magazine) or add a brief comment explaining the reasoning behind 4096 so a future reader doesn't treat it as arbitrary.

review_comment: Please note that with the current implementation we would always stay in the same chunk when trying to increase the capacity.
That's not going to work so well, since we pointer-bump allocate from chunks.
